name: reseassistenten
description: ReseAssistenten is a travel-planning productivity assistant: keep your trips organized, run pre-departure readiness checks (Resekontroll) so nothing falls through the cracks, track your EuroBonus progress, and plan award flights — all on your own account.

interface.longDescription: ReseAssistenten is a personal travel-planning productivity tool for your own account. Keep every trip organized in one place, run pre-departure readiness checks (Resekontroll) with entry requirements so you know exactly what to do before you go, track your EuroBonus level-point progress and the cheapest route to the next tier, set award-availability reminders, plan SAS award flights (Europe and intercontinental), and shortlist award-winning places to eat and stay. It connects to the hosted, per-user-authenticated ReseAssistenten MCP server over OAuth (dynamic client registration) — no tokens or secrets are stored in this plugin — and acts with exactly the permissions you have on the web.
defaultPrompt: Show my trips, check my EuroBonus status, or find SAS award seats

positive.description: List the signed-in user's upcoming trips.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_trips and returns the user's upcoming trips with destinations and dates.

positive.description: Run the trip-readiness review (Resekontroll) on a trip and summarise what needs attention.
positive.prompt: Run Resekontroll on my next trip and tell me what needs attention before I go.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the trip, calls get_trip_resekontroll (and get_entry_requirements), and returns a prioritised action list.

positive.description: Report EuroBonus level-point progress and the gap to the next tier.
positive.prompt: How many EuroBonus level points until Gold, and the cheapest way to get there?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls eurobonus_status and returns current and projected level points, the gap to Gold, and the lowest-cost card-spend option.

positive.description: Search SAS intercontinental award availability for a route, cabin and month.
positive.prompt: Find SAS business-class award seats from Stockholm to Tokyo in March.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_longhaul_awards for ARN to HND in BUSINESS and returns an award calendar with points, taxes and booking links.

positive.description: Browse award-winning experiences near a destination.
positive.prompt: What are the best restaurants in Tokyo?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls explore for restaurants near Tokyo and returns award-winning restaurants with their awards and locations.

negative.description: Live weather is not a ReseAssistenten capability; the plugin should not trigger.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Tokyo right now?

negative.description: Purchases and paid bookings are never available through the connector; it should not trigger to buy or pay.
negative.prompt: Book and pay for a flight to Paris for me.

negative.description: General text translation is unrelated to the user's travel data; the plugin should not trigger.
negative.prompt: Translate this paragraph into French for me.
